name: codex-flint
description: High-signal response flint for Codex CLI. Three modes: lite, full, ultra. Reduces token waste without sacrificing technical accuracy. Inspired by caveman by Julius Brussee.

interface.shortDescription: Flint Codex responses — lite, full, or ultra mode
interface.longDescription: CODEX-FLINT activates high-signal response flint. Three modes: lite (drop filler), full (drop articles, fragments OK), ultra (MetaGlyph symbols, Chain-of-Draft, maximal abbreviation). Flag file persists mode across turns. Auto-safety: security warnings and irreversible ops always get full prose.
